limitations.note: The agent correctly registered the read output but also made out-of-range reads return zero instead of preserving the unknown value from an out-of-range array access.
The valid-address checks exercised the timing fix, but the out-of-range check expected the newly invented zero result and therefore could not catch that behavior change.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected before it ran, so the agent had to resubmit the test with different cleanup.
